Game Overview

7x7 Ultimate is a match-3 game built around slide and strategize as you align colorful blocks on a dynamic grid. Make lines of four or more to clear them, but beware—each non-matching move brings more blocks. Test your tactical skills in this addictive puzzle challenge, and keep the board from overflowing! Can you master the ultimate grid?
